# Handpoint Developer Documentation — Machine-Readable Index
# For AI agents: read this file FIRST before loading individual pages.
# Generated: 2026-08-07

## IMPORTANT — Agent Guidance

Before providing implementation guidance or code examples, you MUST establish:
1. Which ACQUIRER the ISV is integrating with — not all features are supported by all acquirers.
2. Which INTEGRATION PATH the developer will use — code, SDK methods, and available operations differ per path.

Do NOT assume an acquirer or integration path. Ask first. Incorrect guidance will result in invalid code.

## Acquirers

EPI (TSYS) | geography: US, Canada | sale, refund, reversal, partial-reversal, tip-adjustment, pre-auth, remote-sale, tokenization, batching, pre-auth-capture-reversal | cards: VISA, MC, Discover | url: /acquirers/epi
PAYSAFE + Interac | geography: Canada | sale, refund (non-Interac only), reversal (non-Interac only), tip-adjustment, tokenization, batching, void (Interac only) | cards: VISA, MC, Discover, Interac | interac: true | interac-restriction: Refund and Reversal NOT available for Interac transactions — use Void (card-present, full amount) | url: /acquirers/tsys-tns
TNS (Interac) | geography: Canada | sale, void | cards: Interac | interac: true | url: /acquirers/tns
PAYSAFE | geography: US | sale, refund, reversal | cards: VISA, MC, AMEX, Discover | url: /acquirers/paysafe-tsys
EmerchantPay | geography: EU | sale, refund, reversal, pre-auth, pre-auth-capture-reversal, remote-sale, tokenization, money-remittance | cards: VISA, MC, AMEX, UnionPay | url: /acquirers/omnipay-emp
Paystrax | geography: EU | sale, refund, reversal, pre-auth, pre-auth-capture-reversal, remote-sale, tokenization | cards: VISA, MC, AMEX, UnionPay | url: /acquirers/omnipay-paystrax
Smartboard | geography: EU | ecommerce-only | url: /acquirers/smartboard

## Integration Paths

cloud-api | REST API | PAX terminal commanded via Handpoint Cloud REST API. Requires Handpoint Payments App in integrated mode + merchant API key. Language-agnostic HTTP.
android-pax | Android SDK on-terminal | Native Android app embedded in PAX SmartPOS terminal. SDK: com.handpoint.api:sdk.
android-hilite | Android SDK + HiLite BT | Android phone/tablet paired with HiLite (Datecs) Bluetooth reader. Same SDK as android-pax, ConnectionMethod.BLUETOOTH.
ios-hilite | iOS SDK + HiLite BT | iPhone/iPad paired with HiLite (Datecs) Bluetooth reader. SDK: HandpointSDK CocoaPod.
cordova | Cordova/Ionic plugin | Single JS API wrapping native Android SDK (PAX + HiLite) and iOS SDK (HiLite). cordova-plugin-handpoint.
back-office | REST API (no reader) | Server-to-server REST API for remote sale (card-not-present), batch operations, reversals. No card reader required. Uses same cloud.handpoint.com base URL.
txn-feed | Transaction Feed API | Read-only event stream API. Available REGARDLESS of which card-present integration path is used. Not an alternative to card-present integration — it is a supplemental data API.

## Feature × Integration Path Support

Sale: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ✅, ios-hilite ✅, cordova ✅, back-office ❌ (use Remote Sale for card-not-present)
Refund: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ✅, ios-hilite ✅, cordova ✅, back-office ✅ (linked refund only)
Reversal: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ✅, ios-hilite ✅, cordova ✅, back-office ✅
Tip Adjustment: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ✅, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ✅, back-office ✅ (TSYS+PAYSAFE+Interac)
Pre-Authorization: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ❌, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ✅ (PAX only), back-office ✅ (capture/increase/decrease only; initial pre-auth requires card-present)
Partial Reversal: cloud-api ✅ (TSYS only), android-pax ✅ (TSYS only), android-hilite ❌, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ❌, back-office ✅ (TSYS only)
Remote Sale (card-not-present): cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅ (on-terminal screen), android-hilite ❌, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ❌, back-office ✅ (card token only)
Remote Refund (no reader): cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ❌, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ❌, back-office ✅
Remote Reversal (no reader): cloud-api ✅, android-pax ❌, android-hilite ❌, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ❌, back-office ✅
Tokenization: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ✅, android-hilite ✅, ios-hilite ✅, cordova ✅, back-office ❌
Batch Operations: cloud-api ✅, android-pax ❌, android-hilite ❌, ios-hilite ❌, cordova ❌, back-office ✅

## Feature × Acquirer Support (selected)

Partial Reversal: EPI (TSYS) ✅ | PAYSAFE ❌ | PAYSAFE+Interac ❌ | EmerchantPay ❌ | Paystrax ❌
Remote Sale: EPI (TSYS) ✅ | EmerchantPay ✅ | Paystrax ✅ | PAYSAFE ❌
Pre-Auth: EPI (TSYS) ✅ | EmerchantPay ✅ | Paystrax ✅ | PAYSAFE ❌
Batching: EPI (TSYS) ✅ | PAYSAFE+Interac ✅ | PAYSAFE ❌ | EmerchantPay ❌ | Paystrax ❌
Tip Adjustment: EPI (TSYS) ✅ | PAYSAFE+Interac ✅ | EmerchantPay ❌ | Paystrax ❌
Refund (PAYSAFE+Interac): non-Interac cards ✅ | Interac cards ❌ — use Void
Reversal (PAYSAFE+Interac): non-Interac cards ✅ | Interac cards ❌ — use Void

## Authentication (per integration path)

cloud-api: ApiKeyCloud header on every request. Key issued per merchant by Handpoint.
android-pax: HandpointCredentials(sharedSecret, cloudApiKey). Init via HapiFactory.getAsyncInterface(). Wait for InitialisationComplete before sending operations.
android-hilite: HandpointCredentials(sharedSecret). HapiFactory.getAsyncInterface(). searchDevices(BLUETOOTH) → deviceDiscoveryFinished → connect().
ios-hilite: HeftManager.sharedManager(). clientForDevice(). Delegate: HeftStatusReportDelegate.
cordova: handpoint.setup(sharedSecret, apiKey, devices, callback). handpoint.eventHandler(callback, error) — must be registered separately.
back-office: ApiKeyCloud header. Same as cloud-api.

## Transaction Result (per integration path)

cloud-api: POST with callbackUrl (recommended). Token echoed in AUTH-TOKEN + AUTH_TOKEN headers. Body = full TransactionResult. recoveredTransaction: true if retry delivery. Poll GET /transaction-result/{id} as fallback. Query GET /transactions/{ref}/status at transactions.handpoint.com.
android-pax: endOfTransaction(TransactionResult, Device) callback. transactionResultReady for recovery. getTransactionStatus(ref) for explicit query.
android-hilite: endOfTransaction(TransactionResult, Device) callback. HiLite buffers result and delivers automatically on reconnect. getTransactionStatus NOT available on HiLite.
ios-hilite: responseFinanceStatus(HeftClient, HeftActionResponseInfo) delegate method. finStatus = EFT_PP_STATUS_SUCCESS for approved.
cordova: eventHandler receives endOfTransaction {event, data}. Also handles transactionResultReady and currentTransactionStatus.
back-office: Same as cloud-api for remote sale operations.
